title: 29% Of Americans Now Report No Religion
closing: The country's religious map is changing within a single generation.
question: Has your community changed too?

segments.say: In 1990, 8% of adults reported no religion. The unaffiliated share has climbed sharply since then.
Among millennials, 36% report no religion. The shift is strongest in younger generations.
Today, 28% identify as unaffiliated. That share now exceeds the Catholic share.
